whoItsFor: Developers who want an AI coding workbench, whether as a desktop app, a browser UI, or a terminal agent. It also suits contributors working on the client, server, or Agent CLI source in this repo.
useCases: Run an AI coding agent from the desktop app to work on local projects
Start a browser-based coding workspace with `zcode --web` on a chosen project
Drive an AI coding agent from the terminal TUI
